text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Placed on the board... I believe this is 
by no means a bad result.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Looking at the race as a whole, there 
were no major mistakes, so I'm sure I was 
able to deliver at least something to all 
the fans..."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
choice_data_list: You're really not satisfied yet, are you?
You're really not satisfied yet, right?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. So many people gave us their warm 
cheers.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"However, there were quite a few voices 
expressing regret that I fell just short, 
as well as words of encouragement urging 
me to do my best next time."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that made me happy, but at the 
same time, I was filled with frustration 
and regret...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Only when both sides clash with 
everything they have can a wonderful race 
that leads to hope be born."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I gave it everything I had. 
But— I feel my running this time was 
somewhat lacking in strength...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"That is why next time— I pledge to 
deliver a race that reaches everyone's 
hearts and becomes their beacon of hope!"
choice_data_list:
We'll definitely fulfill that vow 
together!

First, let's review what needs improvement 
from today.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let's make it the best race ever. A 
race that unites the hearts of everyone in 
the audience!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Let us reflect on what I was 
lacking today.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Because that will surely be the shortest 
path to bringing hope."
